host_reservations: Claude did not execute runtime tests, browse current tariffs or audit the concurrent implementation; its response is architectural consultation.
Do not delete the episode after export or delete the user-chosen exported document. Clean only owned temporary files; browser downloads/spool/OS surfaces remain distinct.
Prefer one canonical transport header. X-Emergency-Revision selected by implementation is equivalent to Claude proposed X-Emergency-Build if bound and negatively tested.
A monotonic anti-rollback proposal must not prevent the requested owner-authorized rollback. Refuse untrusted/revoked/incompatible releases; do not infer an implemented revocation service.
Do not adopt documented loss of preferences as completion if same-origin update fails. Preserve the requirement and mark the implementation pending.
The exact bundled/checked Python runtime may differ from the model hypothetical Python3.12 preinstallation; do not impose a needless global installation.
CSP connect-src self bounds browser fetch, not Python or all OS egress. Runtime provider/environment/network controls need their own tests.

Do not exclude deterministic blood-gas functions solely because T05 OCR is a lab adapter. Existing required individual routes determine the bundle; lab/LLM/MCP product capabilities remain separately scoped.
An Emergency MCP tool may be operational for the coordinator while not bundled in the individual clinical application; source absence is not tool unavailability.
BitLocker/FileVault and device ACL observations are risk safeguards, not a newly imposed universal blocker for synthetic installation. No unmeasured encryption or zero-disk-write claim.
The newer Work cost cotejo confirms CloudRun Madrid/Belgium tier1 while SQL EU tariff remains unconfirmed. Claude repeats older uncertainty; no new price was verified by this consultation.
Cloud technical portability does not mean public deployment of the local BFF: the future production boundary/authentication is separate.
